updates.content:
Title: Some users may experience delays or failures when receiving responses from Microsoft 365 Copilot

User impact: Users may experience delays or failures when receiving responses from Microsoft 365 Copilot.

More info: Affected users may encounter error responses, delayed completions, or requests that fail to complete when using Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Declarative Agents, and Copilot for Education experiences.

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the root cause and determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some users attempting to receive responses from Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Declarative Agents, and Copilot for Education experiences.

Next update by: Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 5:00 PM UTC
